mentions.claim_text: He says a shaking will take place in California, Oregon and Washington, and that the natural shaking represents a shaking in the spirit from the cold to the hot.
mentions.quote: A shaking will take place in California. A shaking will take place in Oregon
mentions.falsify_match: Significant earthquakes in all three Pacific states in one period.
mentions.falsify_miss: No notable seismic events in Oregon or Washington.

mentions.claim_text: He says water will spring forth boiling hot like a geyser out of the land of California, which he gives as the sign of a greater revival flowing through the state.
mentions.quote: hot water will flow out of you in the land of California
mentions.falsify_match: A recognised revival movement takes hold in California.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such movement emerges.

mentions.claim_text: He states twice that the hot water is symbolic and that the Lord told him so, meaning that there is too much cold and he will make people hot.
mentions.quote: It's symbolic. The Lord say it's symbolic
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing physical is required, so only a change in church fervour could match it.
mentions.falsify_miss: Marked as symbolic in advance, so no physical outcome can falsify it.

mentions.claim_text: He says the shakings start small and get big, that God's grace has held it back but his hand is coming off, and that he sees 8.0 magnitude quakes shaking California.
mentions.quote: My grace has held it back, but his hand is coming off this
mentions.time_phrase: start out small and get big
mentions.falsify_match: A magnitude 8 or greater earthquake strikes California.
mentions.falsify_miss: No California earthquake above magnitude 7 occurs.

mentions.claim_text: He calls voter fraud to be uncovered and addresses the California governor directly, saying he will not be president of the United States because of the scandals.
mentions.quote: you will not be the president of the United States of America
mentions.falsify_match: Newsom never becomes president.
mentions.falsify_miss: Newsom wins the presidency.

mentions.claim_text: He sees corruption and repeated files on Gavin Newsom, Nancy Pelosi and Kamala Harris, and asks whether Harris came out of California.
mentions.quote: I see corruption. And I see files
mentions.falsify_match: Documented corruption findings emerge against those three named figures.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such findings against any of them.

mentions.claim_text: He commands unconstitutional and illegitimate ballots to be uncovered and asks for a fair election, with bad practice exposed in either party.
mentions.quote: ballots that are not legitimate. We command these to be uncovered
mentions.falsify_match: A documented ballot fraud case is uncovered around the 2026 midterms.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such case emerges.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord will deal with it, and names a shaking of Islam in New York and a shaking of Islam in Boston.
mentions.quote: A shaking of Islam in New York. A shaking in Islam of Boston
mentions.falsify_match: A major disruption to Muslim communities or institutions in New York and Boston.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing of the kind in either city.

mentions.claim_text: He prays that the vice president's heart does not turn to be a Judas, that he backs the president, takes no counsel from the ungodly and does not turn reprobate.
mentions.quote: even for JD Vance that his heart does not turn to be a Judas
mentions.falsify_match: Vance publicly breaks with the president.
mentions.falsify_miss: Vance remains loyal through the term.

mentions.claim_text: He declares that Cuba will be like a state with an economy that flourishes and great opportunity for the Cuban people after decades, and says it happens now.
mentions.quote: it will be like a state and it will be an economy that will flourish
mentions.falsify_match: Cuba's economy opens and grows sharply under a new arrangement with America.
mentions.falsify_miss: Cuba's economy and political status are unchanged.

mentions.claim_text: He says that in a vision the previous night he saw a major tidal wave hundreds of feet high, a massive wall of water, come into New York City and hit all along the east coast with complete devastation.
mentions.quote: I saw a major tidal wave come into New York City
mentions.falsify_match: A tsunami or surge of that scale strikes New York and the east coast.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such wave occurs.

mentions.claim_text: A sung prophetic word declaring that what can be shaken will be shaken and what cannot be shaken will remain, with a reference to the games played in the house they call white.
mentions.quote: that which can be shaken will be shaken
mentions.falsify_match: A period of visible national upheaval centred on the White House.
mentions.falsify_miss: An uneventful autumn.

mentions.claim_text: He notes that the sung word included the college campuses, which he says he had not heard while it was being sung, alongside the tsunami wave and Israel.
mentions.quote: The Lord called us praying over the college campuses
mentions.falsify_match: A campus revival movement emerges at American universities.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such movement.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw shakings beginning from solar flares erupting on the sun, shakings in the Mississippi, and earthquakes beginning in Missouri around magnitude 4, given as warnings under the words if you split my land I will split yours.
mentions.quote: If you split my land, I will split yours
mentions.falsify_match: Magnitude 4 range earthquakes recorded in Missouri on the New Madrid system.
mentions.falsify_miss: No notable Missouri seismicity.

mentions.claim_text: He says he felt a sickening feeling when the president made the decision about Gaza and the peace treaty, that something was off, and that they must pray for the president.
mentions.quote: I felt like this sickening feeling inside of me
mentions.falsify_match: The Gaza agreement turns out badly for Israel or for the president.
mentions.falsify_miss: The agreement holds without harm.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is easier to pray for the current president than the alternative, that he agrees with some but not all of his policies, and that people can agree to disagree.
mentions.quote: I agree with some of his policies. I don't agree with everything
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing to match; a statement of personal position.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing to miss; no forward content.

mentions.claim_text: He says he does not agree with the genocide of children or everything Israel has done, stands for the peace of Jerusalem, rejects replacement theology, and that the Lord said he is raising up a new leader.
mentions.quote: the Lord said to me, I'm raising up a new leader
mentions.falsify_match: A new Israeli leader takes over.
mentions.falsify_miss: Israeli leadership continues unchanged.

mentions.claim_text: He adds that the new Israeli leader is more traditional, looks younger and does not have silver hair, seen with something on his head, coming soon, while others try to bring back a former prime minister.
mentions.quote: he's more traditional and he would look younger
mentions.falsify_match: A younger, observant Israeli leader takes office rather than Bennett.
mentions.falsify_miss: Bennett or another older figure returns instead.

mentions.claim_text: He says they will come highly against Elon Musk in the days ahead with lawsuit after lawsuit from foreign nations in Europe to try to dethrone him, but that his platform will be exalted and go up even as they try to pull the plug.
mentions.quote: Lawsuit after lawsuit, you will see to try to dethrone him
mentions.falsify_match: European legal actions against Musk multiply while X grows.
mentions.falsify_miss: No new European actions and the platform stagnates.

mentions.claim_text: He says the legacy media are losing their audience and know it, that they must regain a foothold, that X is growing substantially, and that even the judges will look for a crackdown on that platform.
mentions.quote: Fake news is losing their platform
mentions.falsify_match: Legacy media audiences fall further while X grows and faces legal pressure.
mentions.falsify_miss: Legacy audiences recover and no crackdown materialises.

mentions.claim_text: On a measure making illegal content a new criminal offence, he says the intention is to crack down on all of it, naming TikTok and other platforms, and says he saw even more of it aimed at X.
mentions.quote: they want to crack down on all of it
mentions.falsify_match: Speech restrictions expand across major platforms.
mentions.falsify_miss: The measure fails or is not applied.

mentions.claim_text: He says he had stated that when this takes place three hundred thousand people die on the coastline, showing footage of boulders crushing cars from a magnitude 4 quake, and repeats an 8.2 at Rome with the Vatican walls cracking.
mentions.quote: I saw 300,000 people die on the coastline
mentions.falsify_match: An Italian coastal disaster with casualties in the hundreds of thousands.
mentions.falsify_miss: No Italian event approaching that scale.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw China and North Korea rising up as a team and called the North Korean leader a social pariah, with China offering him terms if he follows them.
mentions.quote: I saw China and North Korea rising up as a team
mentions.falsify_match: A formal China and North Korea military alignment against the West.
mentions.falsify_miss: Relations stay as they are.

mentions.claim_text: He says North Korea grows bolder and stronger every day, and repeats that he saw Japan, Taiwan and South Korea on the border toward the water where there will be a conflict.
mentions.quote: I saw Japan, Taiwan, and South Korea on the border
mentions.falsify_match: An armed confrontation involving those three states at sea.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such confrontation.

mentions.claim_text: He reads out reported Ukrainian and Russian battlefield deaths of twenty five thousand soldiers in a month against thirty two thousand the month before, and calls the numbers staggering and unreported.
mentions.quote: 25,000 people a month are dying. Nobody's talking about that
mentions.falsify_match: Casualty figures at that scale are confirmed.
mentions.falsify_miss: The figures are shown to be far lower.

mentions.claim_text: He says four nations including England and Australia combine, that the man he calls Pinocchio gets his way and becomes a cobra that goes down, and repeats World War III with the black horse riding in Europe and a strike on Poland.
mentions.quote: I saw World War III and the black horse riding upon the land in Europe
mentions.falsify_match: Russia strikes Poland and a world war is declared.
mentions.falsify_miss: No strike on Poland and no wider war declaration.

mentions.claim_text: He sees attacks coming from Iran against Saudi Arabia, identified by green and white, naming the crown prince and his oil, with fires in Saudi Arabia and Iraq attacked as well.
mentions.quote: I see Saudi Arabia and I see fires
mentions.falsify_match: Iranian strikes hit Saudi oil facilities and set fires.
mentions.falsify_miss: No attacks on Saudi oil infrastructure.

mentions.claim_text: He closes the two and a half hour broadcast, thanking the audience for praying for the president, his family and the nations.
mentions.quote: I kept you two hours and 30 minutes
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing to match; a sign off.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing to miss; no forward content.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats that the Lord said decisions have been made in the valley of decision.
mentions.quote: Decisions have been made is what he said in the valley of decision
mentions.falsify_match: Decisions taken now visibly determine the midterm outcome.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such decisive choice is identifiable.

mentions.claim_text: He says a Gaza master plan will be built in phases, that Middle Eastern cities of two or three million are built in three years, and that he saw a golf course carrying the president's name with a flag in the ninth hole.
mentions.quote: I saw a golf course with Trump's name on it
mentions.falsify_match: A Trump branded golf course is built in Gaza.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such development.

mentions.claim_text: He adds that the flag in the ninth hole was an Israeli flag, with the course beside the Mediterranean and white stucco mansions with rooftop terraces behind it resembling Miami.
mentions.quote: it was an Israeli flag and it was in the ninth hole
mentions.falsify_match: Luxury Mediterranean development on the Gaza coast under Israeli control.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such development.

mentions.claim_text: He points to what the vice president said to the Israeli prime minister as matching his instruction to watch Judas and watch what he says to Benjamin, and says he saw things he was not allowed to share.
mentions.quote: Judas, watch Judas. Watch what he says to Benjamin
mentions.falsify_match: A public betrayal of the president or of Israel from inside the administration.
mentions.falsify_miss: No betrayal materialises.

mentions.claim_text: He says Russia will strike Poland with a massive non-nuclear weapon causing a major explosion on a town right by Warsaw on the border, and that this is what will officially start a world war.
mentions.quote: Russia will strike Poland and you will see a major explosion
mentions.falsify_match: A large Russian non-nuclear strike lands near Warsaw.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such strike on Polish territory.

mentions.claim_text: Pointing at a map, he says he saw a rocket come out of Russia and hit that exact area near the border, and that it was massive.
mentions.quote: I saw a rocket come out of Russia and hit right here
mentions.falsify_match: A Russian missile strikes the area he indicates.
mentions.falsify_miss: No strike in that area.

mentions.claim_text: He replays his earlier recording and says he told the audience where it would hit, repeating that this is what will start a world war and that it is right by Warsaw.
mentions.quote: This is what's going to start to stimulate World War II
mentions.falsify_match: A world war is declared following a strike near Warsaw.
mentions.falsify_miss: No wider war follows.

mentions.claim_text: He notes Russia is using North Korean missiles, which he says he called, and that Ukraine struck and blew up more Russian oil.
mentions.quote: Russia is using North Korean missiles and I said they will join the fight
mentions.falsify_match: Continued Ukrainian strikes destroying Russian refining capacity.
mentions.falsify_miss: Strikes on Russian oil stop.

mentions.claim_text: He plays a clip of a Lebanese official thanking Turkey for standing by Lebanon and for its role in the UN force, without drawing a claim from it.
mentions.quote: Turkey has always been by our side
mentions.falsify_match: Turkish influence over Lebanon deepens.
mentions.falsify_miss: No change in the arrangement.

mentions.claim_text: On a report of a magnitude 1.8 solar flare he says the Lord had told them the sun would become very active and cause great earthquakes and disruption to the earth in the days ahead.
mentions.quote: the sun was going to become very active and cause great earthquakes
mentions.falsify_match: A period of high solar activity coincides with major earthquakes.
mentions.falsify_miss: Solar activity declines and no such quakes follow. Note the flare he cites is an M1.8, an ordinary class flare of which there are hundreds per solar cycle.

mentions.claim_text: He says he was told there would be warnings, and sees the Mississippi River shaking and Missouri shaking, repeating you divide my land and I will divide yours, with an angel blowing a horn.
mentions.quote: I see the Mississippi River shaking. I see Missouri shaking
mentions.falsify_match: A significant New Madrid earthquake.
mentions.falsify_miss: No notable New Madrid activity.

mentions.claim_text: He sees a major volcano going off in Hawaii, and recalls an angel he says was sent to observe a church before its pastor fell, given as a judgment coming.
mentions.quote: I see a major volcano going off in Hawaii
mentions.falsify_match: A major Hawaiian eruption. Note Kilauea has erupted repeatedly through this period, so the bar for a match must be an unusually large event.
mentions.falsify_miss: No eruption beyond the ordinary Hawaiian pattern.

mentions.claim_text: He names the Trail of Tears and Tennessee, saying the people were driven off land that was theirs and not America's, and that a red line was crossed.
mentions.quote: You drive out the people of their land
mentions.falsify_match: He ties a specific later disaster back to this as the reason.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such tie is made; the grounds stay retrospective.

mentions.claim_text: He says a shaking is coming to New York and to Wall Street, calls it the shaking of the economy, and says a horn is being blown over New York with bells ringing.
mentions.quote: A shaking is coming to New York. To Wall Street
mentions.falsify_match: A major American market crash centred on New York.
mentions.falsify_miss: Markets continue without a major dislocation.

mentions.claim_text: He prays that the land waits for the glorious church to rise and thanks God for the army he calls the remnant, saying the church will rise up.
mentions.quote: the land is waiting for the glorious church to rise
mentions.falsify_match: A visible movement matching what he calls the remnant emerges.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such movement.

mentions.claim_text: He says he does not agree with every decision Israel has made but stands with the peace of Jerusalem and prays for its leadership, citing the blessing on those who bless Israel.
mentions.quote: do I stand with the peace of Israel? Yes, with all my heart
mentions.falsify_match: America is blessed in proportion to its support for Israel.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such correlation appears.

mentions.claim_text: He prays that God shake the vice president and his family if needed so that he comes to an intimate relationship with him, and the same for the president.
mentions.quote: even if you had to you shake JD Vance and his family
mentions.falsify_match: A public change of religious posture by the vice president.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such change.

mentions.claim_text: He prays over Poland and over Europe, and says there are some things they cannot stop and some things they can.
mentions.quote: There's some things we cannot stop and there's some things we can
mentions.falsify_match: The Poland escalation is averted after this prayer.
mentions.falsify_miss: The escalation proceeds. Both outcomes are covered in advance by the stated split.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord told him his channel would go from six hundred thousand to one point two million and that it would happen quickly, alongside a statement that God does not need his help but his obedience.
mentions.quote: my channel would go from 600,000 to 1.2 million
mentions.falsify_match: The channel reaches 1.2 million subscribers.
mentions.falsify_miss: Subscriber growth stalls well below that.

mentions.claim_text: He recounts being corrected while looking for the scripture about God making his name great, citing the line about the house of his servant David being established.
mentions.quote: let your name be magnified forever
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing to match; scriptural reflection.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing to miss; no forward content.

mentions.claim_text: He cites another church fire, a building over a hundred years old burned down, as the church fires he warned were coming to Europe, Canada and America.
mentions.quote: they're going to burn your churches in Europe
mentions.falsify_match: A sustained rise in arson attacks on churches across those three regions.
mentions.falsify_miss: Church fire rates stay at their long term level. Canadian church arsons have run at elevated rates since 2021, which weakens this as a call.

mentions.claim_text: Told of a report that Iran is about to receive four hundred rocket launchers from China through Pakistan, he says he would be surprised because he was told strongly that China would not partake, and that China will be disappointed.
mentions.quote: He told me very strongly he wouldn't partake
mentions.falsify_match: Chinese rocket launchers are confirmed delivered to Iran.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such transfer occurs.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord told him he scattered them and is now going to bring them home, referring to Jews leaving New York, Austin and Europe for Israel, and questions why the president keeps posting Bay of Pigs imagery.
mentions.quote: I scattered them and now I'm going to bring them home
mentions.falsify_match: A large wave of Jewish emigration from America and Europe to Israel.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such wave.

mentions.claim_text: He notes Poland met the Ukrainian president that day and says this is the escalation he told the audience they would see, and that it should concern anyone not praying.
mentions.quote: this is what I told you that you're going to see an escalation
mentions.falsify_match: Poland is drawn formally into the war.
mentions.falsify_miss: Poland stays out.

mentions.claim_text: With Polish alert sirens reported an hour earlier, he repeats that Russia will strike Poland with an unconventional weapon of war that hits Warsaw and destroys about a fifty mile radius, after which World War III is announced and North Korea follows.
mentions.quote: it will hit Warsaw and it will destroy about 50 mile radius
mentions.falsify_match: A weapon strikes Warsaw with a blast radius of that order.
mentions.falsify_miss: No strike on Warsaw. Note that the sirens he cites are an air alert, not a strike.

mentions.claim_text: He says this is real and is what the Lord warned them about, that they are the news rather than waiting for it, and repeats the instruction to watch Poland and pray for Poland.
mentions.quote: I said, Watch Poland. That's what the Lord said
mentions.falsify_match: A major escalation occurs in Poland.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing beyond airspace alerts occurs in Poland.

mentions.claim_text: He reads breaking news that Russian cruise missiles have been reported crossing into Polish airspace, and says the Lord warns ahead of time so that people can pray over what he tells them to pray over.
mentions.quote: Russian cruise missiles reported crossing into Polish airspace
mentions.falsify_match: Confirmed Russian missile incursion into Polish airspace.
mentions.falsify_miss: The report is not confirmed or is a drone rather than a cruise missile.
